response.query: How will we model input dependencies (copulas, conditional Sobol, PCA/active subspaces, Shapley), which copula families and estimation routines will be used, and how will dependent-input indices be mapped and interpreted spatially?
response.answer: We will model input dependencies using copulas, conditional Sobol indices, and PCA/active subspaces. Gaussian copulas will be used for estimation, and dependent-input indices will be mapped using spatial principal components.

results.title: Rcpp: Seamless R and C++ Integration
results.content: * The zic package implements Bayesian inference for zero-inflated count models using MCMC written in C++; the package uses Rcpp and RcppArmadillo. * The HLMdiag package provides a suite of diagnostic tools for hierarchical (multilevel) linear models; it uses Rcpp and RcppArmadillo. * The FBFsearch package implements an algorithm for searching the space of Gaussian directed acyclic graphical models through moment fractional Bayes factors (and uses Rcpp and RcppArmadillo). * The GSE package implements robust estimation of multivariate location and scatter in the presence of missing data, it use Rcpp and RcppArmadillo. * The lme4 package implements S4 based classes and functions to fit linear mixed-effects models; it uses Rcpp and RcppEigen. * The GMCM package implements fast estimation of Gaussian Mixture Copula Models (GMCM) for unsupervised clustering and meta-analysis; it uses Rcpp and RcppArmadillo. * bdsm implements methods for building and analyzing models based on panel data; it uses Rcpp and RcppArmadillo.
